checks.title: Manual Core security and permission gate review
evidence: Threat boundary and connector permission review

checks.title: Manual requirement and acceptance traceability check
evidence: Source revision and approved requirement IDs
Acceptance scenario references and unresolved decisions

checks.title: Review scope, reuse and architecture fit
evidence: New/maintain/mixed scope per affected module and authoritative convention sources
Search scope, reusable public API paths, intended placement and new-code rationale
No dependency cycles, parallel common framework, unrelated refactor or unused code; report exceptions
Actual configured checks and manual boundary review, with limitations

checks.title: MVP and architecture impact fit at proportional depth
evidence: Source-linked context and applicable approved MVP/AC/NFR/ADR
Justified pattern/boundary choice and implementation/dependency plan
Actual decisions and verification; no unnecessary full-document gate

checks.title: Verify agent preferences in the actual host
evidence: Declared vs actual model/provider/effort and selected role namespace
Actual delegation/thread semantics or sequential-role limitation
No premium fallback, fake token meter or overwritten host configuration

checks.title: Review input/output ownership, source writes and spec-driven maintenance
evidence: Declared input revisions, output destinations and single canonical owner per group
Actual host connection/access and bounded write authorization; no credentials in project config
Reviewed artifact-impact coverage with docs/spec/UI diffs or explicit blocked dependencies
